newsitem.title: SWEDEN: TI Group bids 189 million pounds for Sweden's Forsheda.
newsitem.headline: TI Group bids 189 million pounds for Sweden's Forsheda.

text.p: Britain's TI Group launched on Monday a 189 million pound ($295.9 million) bid for Swedish polymers group Forsheda in a move it said would double the size of its polymer engineering operation.
"The merger will create a business with an annual turnover of 300 million pounds and the potential to become a global leader," TI board chairman Christopher Lewinton said in a statement.

TI bid 247.50 crowns cash for each A-series share in rubber and sealings group Forsheda, and 225 crowns cash for each B-share in a deal it said offered a premium of 39 to 44 percent over the last price paid for Forsheda's two share classes.

Forsheda later said it recommended shareholders in the Swedish company to accept the offer, and Sweden's Agora Group, which controls 20.6 percent of the share capital in Forsheda and around 63.6 percent of the votes, has already done so.

The offer is conditional on TI gaining control over 90 percent of the voting rights in Forsheda, but TI said it retained the right to complete the acquisition even if this condition were not fulfilled.
The offer period runs from October 14 to November 8.

Lewinton said the two groups' products complemented each other well, and that TI's strength on the international markets would enable a rapid, global expansion of Forsheda's products whilst TI would benefit from Forsheda's strong position in the Nordic and Baltic regions.

TI's existing Polymer Engineering division is market leader in synthetic rubber seals in the vehicle and avaition industries, TI said. It operates in seven counrtries and had a turnover of around 140 million pounds in 1995.

Forsheda which consists of two business areas, Sealing Systems and Industrial Rubber, had a turnover of 1.4 billion crowns ($211.5 million) in 1995 and posted a pre-tax profit of 224 million crowns. ($1=.6388 Pound) ($1=6.620 Swedish Crown)
